blocks.text: The complete Founder OS: 24 MCPs, 25+ skills, 6 hooks, PARA folders, persistent memory. Run a business from one terminal.
Run a Business from One Terminal

The Founder OS is a five-layer system built on Claude Code. It connects your identity, memory, tools, safety rules, and workflows into one coherent environment, so Claude always knows who you are, what you are working on, and how to act on your behalf without breaking anything.
Five Layers of the Founder OS
Each layer builds on the previous one. Together they give Claude full context, full access, and full protection.
Teaches Claude who you are, every session
Persistent context that builds across sessions
24 bridges to external tools: read, write, send from one terminal
6 safety scripts that run automatically before and after Claude acts
25+ reusable agents for specific tasks: type a slash command to trigger
The PARA method (Projects · Areas · Resources · Archives) organises your second brain so Claude can navigate it without asking where things live.
Eight steps to go from a bare terminal to a fully operational Founder OS.
Create your CLAUDE.md with business context, client list, and behaviour rules.
Create MEMORY.md at ~/.claude/projects/.../memory/MEMORY.md and seed it with one insight.
Install the 6 hooks: chmod +x each one and register them in .claude/settings.json.
Connect the 8 core MCPs: Attio, Slack, Notion, Unipile, Anysite, GitHub, n8n, Filesystem.
Set up your PARA folder structure and alias the second brain in CLAUDE.md.
Run sheal check to confirm environment is healthy before your first real session.
Open a session and run /cockpit to verify all layers connect correctly.
Context loaded. It knows who you are, what you are working on, your preferences, and your corrections from past sessions.
Safety active. Destructive commands are blocked, sensitive files are guarded, every edit is backed up and logged.
Claude uses MCPs to act on your tools: reads your CRM, drafts a message in your voice, sends it, and logs the action. One command, full execution.
No more hunting through tabs or re-pasting notes. Claude knows where everything is.
Start working immediately. No re-explaining who you are or what happened last week.
to check during a client call
CRM, pipeline, notes, and history: all in the terminal, all accessible in one command.
From prospect research to sent DM in under 90 seconds. No manual steps.
Five layers. One terminal. Your entire company: organised, connected, and ready for Claude to navigate.
CLAUDE.md knows you. MEMORY.md remembers. MCPs act. Hooks protect. Skills execute.
